notes: Rule 3 check: catalogue is fully live. zgallerie.com now runs on Shopline (not Shopify/Magento); legacy category slugs of the form /c-<id>-<name>. Reached by DIRECT fetch throughout - no WAF, no proxy needed. The mega-menu is React-rendered and absent from the served HTML, so the complete category tree was recovered from the '2025-2026 Z Gallerie Meganav' object embedded in /cdn/shop/s/prod/tjc9ct4xwyd6jhvv/public/static/zg_bundle.common.js, then every node was opened directly. QTY SOURCE: the rendered listing header 'N items' on each category page. VERIFICATION (Rule 1): (a) for all 22 in-scope categories whose header is under one page, the count of unique data-product-id tiles rendered on page 1 equals the header exactly (e.g. Candle Holders 47/47, Wall Mirrors 39/39, Chandeliers 41/41, Wall Decor 50/50); (b) the two multi-page leaves were enumerated to exhaustion via ?page_num=N - Vases & Canisters returned 72+64 unique tiles = 136 and zero on page 3, Art returned 72+72+71 = 215 and zero on page 4, both matching their headers exactly; (c) children sum to the parent - the union of the five Lighting children (41+1+8+38+7 = 95, minus the single item cross-listed in both Chandeliers and Pendants) is exactly 94, the Lighting parent's header; Wall Mirrors 39 + Floor Mirrors 8 minus 1 shared item = 46, exactly the All Mirrors header. SUBSET/RE-CUT CHECKS (product-ID sets compared, not names): Round Mirrors (15) is 100% contained in Wall Mirrors - a shape re-cut - so it was DROPPED. Barware & Entertaining (8) was DROPPED: 5 of its 8 items (62%) are already in Glassware, and the other 3 are 2 bar carts (furniture) and a cocktail shaker (bar tool), all out of scope. Pendants (1) is cross-listed in Chandeliers; both are kept as distinct nav categories, so the Lighting leaves double-count exactly one item. DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: Floral (40, faux/artificial botanicals); Jewelry Boxes & Storage (12, storage); Gifts & Games (471) and the whole Gift/Holiday/Christmas trees; Placemats & Table Linens (5, textiles); Pillows & Throws, Bedding & Curtains, Rugs (textiles); all Furniture incl. bar carts, desks, outdoor; Sale/Clearance/Best Sellers/New/Shop-by-Room/room-set landing pages; the facet groupings Art by Size, Art by Style and Art by Color, and Lighting by Material - these sit as parallel facet rows in the same dropdown as the explicit colour and size filters and are re-cuts of the same populations. Product titles were read before accepting broad nodes: Candle Holders (47) is entirely holders/hurricanes/candle sconces with zero scented candles; Decorative Objects (60) is sculptures, bookends, coin banks and objets (one reed diffuser only); Wall Decor (50) is wall art/panels/plaques with no wreaths or faux greenery. The Tableware parent itself is a mixed roll-up (it contains bar carts and placemats) so it carries no qty, per the parent-row rule.
